summary: Intchains Group Limited, a Shanghai-based semiconductor foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 18, 2026, consisting solely of unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, attached as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference into its Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine periodic financial-reporting filing, not a special situation; watch only for any future capital-markets or corporate-action disclosure.
